name: @edurankai/mail-engine
description: SMTP transport, inbound processing, delivery queue and bounce handling for EduRankAI Mail.

comments.dependencies: Three, and all three are already dependencies of the application, so the engine adds nothing to install in this repository. That is deliberate: nodemailer, mailparser and imapflow are the code that touches hostile input, and two copies at two versions is two sets of parser bugs to track.
comments.run-from-repo-root: The engine resolves its dependencies from the repository's node_modules. Deploying it standalone means copying mail-engine/ plus this package.json and running npm install — see docs/production-migration.md.
